fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-09-22 (night, 00:10): The lock of the residence of the complainant near Poongodi Layout Residential Colony was found broken and a bicycle and some tools was missing, valued at about Rs. 40,000. The complaint was lodged by Naveen Natarajan (9000000057). Chithra Kannan (mobile 9000000146) was named as a possible person of interest. Ramesh Pandian (9000000469) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. A white van with registration TN-39-YY-1016 was observed near Poongodi Layout Residential Colony. Items referenced in the complaint: a vehicle observation, physical documents and a witness statement. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00194, as the mobile number 9000000146 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Vehicle observation; Physical document; Witness statement
fields.Modus_Operandi: Entry allegedly forced through a broken lock while the house was locked.
